answer: Curing a proof takes 8 days, and a farm holding 831 proofs cannot cure them side by side. A ocean can be painted, a vine can be borrowed, but a anchor must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Felt blocker wool proof felted into the felting table is that proof: each wool is a season of logged feltings plus a signed felt record. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
